final: WITH g AS (SELECT telescref AS tid, AVG(modindex) AS gavg FROM signals GROUP BY telescref), o AS (SELECT AVG(gavg) AS oavg FROM g), gj AS (SELECT g.tid, g.gavg, g.gavg - o.oavg AS diff, o.oavg AS oavg FROM g CROSS JOIN o WHERE o.oavg IS NOT NULL), kept AS (SELECT tid, gavg, diff FROM gj WHERE gavg > oavg), l AS (SELECT AVG(gavg) AS lavg FROM kept), kj AS (SELECT k.tid, k.gavg, k.diff, k.gavg / l.lavg AS ratio FROM kept k CROSS JOIN l WHERE l.lavg IS NOT NULL) SELECT tid, gavg, diff, ratio FROM kj ORDER BY (ratio IS NULL), ratio DESC LIMIT 10
